| L38 | Structural analysis is generic: validation's STR checks and `inspect_structure` report structural rank and the DM/BTF partition only; numerical rank, conditioning and feasibility are judged by the certificate's regularity screen at a converged state (blueprint D05). | `doc:docs/derivations/T01-structural-spec.md` |
| L39 | The structural-zero release (recovery edge E5) leaves no trace record: a trace does not show that it ran. | `doc:docs/recovery-edges.yaml §E5` |
| L23 | More than one recycle loop or region per plan is not exercised by any registered flowsheet; the plan builder's single-loop reading is to be revisited when one is (T02 review N8). | `doc:docs/reviews/T02-review.md` |
| L24 | Not implemented: Wegstein and Aitken acceleration, trust regions, Krylov linear solves, arclength continuation. | `doc:docs/derivations/T02-recycle-spec.md §12`<br>`doc:docs/derivations/T04-globalization-spec.md §14` |
| L25 | Alias certificates cover pressure and temperature copies only (the kinds ADR 0001 D6 gives a tolerance); any other affine redundancy is `uncertified_affine`, retained and listed. | `check:T01.A19` |

| L27 | An EO solve with a dormant PH-type outlet is never certified (UNVERIFIED, RANK_DEFICIENT; T05 §4.7 (a), R-050). | `check:T05.A28` |
| L28 | A single flowing component inside its latent jump is solved causally only; on the EO path it ends typed or not VERIFIED, never VERIFIED (T05 §4.7 (b), R-050). | `doc:docs/derivations/T05-unit-models-spec.md §4.7` |
| L29 | The PH kernel's accuracy for near-pure feeds is the energy tolerance's resolution; a target inside the latent jump may be refused `ph_ill_conditioned` (T05 §4.4, R-049). | `check:T05.A29` |
| L30 | Degenerate specifications are reported, not certified: a TP outlet of one component at exactly T_sat, conditioning near β → 0 or 1, and a zero-flow SPECIFICATION_CONFLICT (not searched past); a dormant exchanger side gets no second-law judgement. | `doc:docs/derivations/T05b-limitations-spec.md §17` |
| L31 | A state whose verifier projection is refused is judged at its final state: a possible false alarm, never a false pass. | `doc:docs/derivations/K04-F9-spec.md §11` |

| L33 | Scope defaults of T06 §16: results are keyed by component id; a TWO_PHASE split with a vanishing phase is not converted by the solver (the verifier catches the label); three F-BUDGET starts have no cost remedy. | `doc:docs/derivations/T06-corpus-spec.md §16` |
| L34 | A replay bundle references the CasADi wheel by hash and does not embed it; a replay needs the wheel to remain fetchable. | `doc:docs/adr/0006-distribution-data-rights.md §D1` |
| L35 | A tear-path solve that exhausts its budget records `attempts = 0`, the start state and no provenance (K03's registered capped-budget shape). | `doc:docs/derivations/T03-phase-controller-spec.md §13` |
